business_summary: Deere & Company engages in the manufacture and distribution of various equipment worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Production and Precision Agriculture, Small Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Production and Precision Agriculture segment provides four-wheel-drive track and row crop tractors, harvesters, cotton pickers and strippers, sugarcane harvesters and loaders, soil preparation, tillage, seeding, and crop care equipment, as well as application equipment, including sprayers and nutrient management, soil preparation machinery, and related attachments and service parts. The Small Agriculture and Turf segment offers specialty, utility, and compact tractors; self-propelled forage harvesters and attachments; rotary mowers, hay and forage equipment, and utility vehicles; turf and utility equipment, including riding lawn, commercial mowing, and golf course equipment, and utility vehicles, as well as implements for mowing, tilling, snow and debris handling, aerating, residential, commercial, golf, and sports turf care applications. The Construction and Forestry segment provides backhoe loaders, crawler dozers and loaders, four-wheel-drive loaders, excavators, motor graders, articulated dump trucks, skid-steer loaders, milling machines, recyclers, slipform and asphalt pavers, surface miners, compactors, tandem, static rollers, mobile crushers and screens, mobile and stationary asphalt plants, and log harvesters; and road building and rehabilitation equipment. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases agriculture and turf, and construction and forestry equipment. It also offers wholesale financing to dealers of the foregoing equipment; and extended equipment warranties. Deere & Company has a strategic partnership with Tarter USA to develop and produce flex wing rotary cutters. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: Deere & Company는 전 세계적으로 다양한 장비를 제조 및 유통하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 생산 및 정밀 농업, 소규모 농업 및 잔디, 건설 및 임업, 금융 서비스 등 4개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 생산 및 정밀 농업 부문에서는 4륜 구동 트랙 및 행 작물 트랙터, 수확기, 면화 수확기 및 스트리퍼, 사탕수수 수확기 및 로더, 토양 준비, 경작, 파종 및 작물 관리 장비는 물론 분무기 및 영양분 관리, 토양 준비 기계, 관련 부속품 및 서비스 부품을 포함한 응용 장비를 제공합니다. 소규모 농업 및 잔디 부문은 특수, 유틸리티 및 소형 트랙터를 제공합니다. 자체 추진 마초 수확기 및 부착물; 회전식 잔디 깎는 기계, 건초 및 마초 장비, 다용도 차량; 잔디밭 타기, 상업용 잔디 깎기, 골프 코스 장비, 다용도 차량을 포함한 잔디 및 유틸리티 장비, 예초, 경작, 눈 및 잔해 처리, 공기 공급, 주거용, 상업용, 골프 및 스포츠 잔디 관리 응용 분야용 도구. 건설 및 임업 부문은 백호 로더, 크롤러 도저 및 로더를 제공합니다.
